summary: Comprehensive testing of Actoos SaaS multi-tenant field service management app. Fixed 3 critical bugs: 1) PDF generation failing due to None conditions_paiement, 2) Portal link endpoint returning 404 due to route registration order, 3) Dashboard endpoints missing (stats/alerts/recent). All 43 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend dashboard now loads correctly with all KPIs.

fixed_in_this_iteration.issue: PDF generation failed with AttributeError when conditions_paiement was None
fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Added null check with default value in pdf_generator.py

fixed_in_this_iteration.issue: Route returned 404 because it was defined after app.include_router()
fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Moved route definition before include_router() in server.py

fixed_in_this_iteration.issue: Dashboard endpoints missing causing frontend 404 errors
Admin could not complete interventions (only assigned tech could)
fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Updated query to allow admins to complete any intervention

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard endpoints should be moved to a dedicated dashboard router for better organization
Consider adding client_nom field to recent devis/factures response for better display
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_COMPREHENSIVE_ prefix and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical CRUD operations tested and working: Auth, Clients, Interventions, Devis, Factures, Categories, Entreprise settings, Portal, PWA endpoints. Dashboard endpoints added. PDF generation fixed. Plan limits enforcement working.
